# Units of measurement

> **这页管什么**：数字和单位之间用不间断空格；十进制与二进制字节单位不能混。
>
> 来源：<https://developers.google.com/style/units-of-measure> · CC BY 4.0 · 本文件是**规则摘要**，非原文全文。

## Spacing

- Nonbreaking space between a number and its unit — "64&nbsp;GB", "25&nbsp;mm".
- Compound number-unit modifiers take a hyphen, not a space — "a 128-bit system".
- **No space** for money, percentages, and angle degrees — "$10", "65%", "180°".
- Celsius/Fahrenheit: nonbreaking space before the degree symbol, no space between symbol and letter — "50&nbsp;°C".
- Kelvin: no degree symbol, but still a nonbreaking space — "300&nbsp;K".

## Ranges

Repeat the unit for both numbers, and use *to* rather than a hyphen — a hyphen can be misread as a subtraction sign: "-40 °C to 85 °C".

## Multiplied units

Hyphenate — "5 vCPU-hours", "40 person-hours".

## k for thousands

No space between number and *k*. Follow with a noun to avoid confusion with kilobytes — "55k download operations".

## Currency

Clarify which currency when ambiguity is possible — "US$10".

## Rates

Prefer *per* over a slash — "requests per day", not "requests/day". The slash is acceptable only in tight spaces. Established abbreviations shorten *per* to *p* — "Gbps", not "Gb/s".

## Decimal vs binary byte units

Match the unit system to the technology. **Don't mix MB with MiB, or GB with GiB.**

- Decimal: kB (1000), MB (1000²), GB (1000³)
- Binary: KiB (1024), MiB (1024²), GiB (1024³)
